title: A Pipeline That Pays: Leads To Loyalty with Brianna Flynn
description: This class will show you how to build a simple pipeline that turns leads into long-term clients. You’ll learn how to stay organized, follow up the right way, and build strong relationships that lead to repeat business and referrals. It’s designed to help you keep things clear, consistent, and easy to manage.

title: The Weekly Real Estate Playbook with Eric Bradley
description: Join The Weekly Real Estate Playbook with Eric Bradley, a dynamic class designed to help agents stay informed, focused, and ready to take action. Each session blends timely market stats, economic updates, proven business strategies, and mindset conversations that support long-term success. You’ll also gain insights from top agent interviews, offering real-world perspectives you can apply immediately to your business.
